filing_manager_name.description: Cover-page filing-manager name (e.g., 'VANGUARD GROUP INC'). Note: the filer-agent CIK in the EDGAR submission is often the filing agent, not the manager itself.

report_calendar_quarter_end.description: Period of report. Filed in MM-DD-YYYY format on the cover page; normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD before comparison.

is_amendment.description: True for 13F-HR/A. When true, supersedes the original for the same (manager, period). Output null when the cover page does not state amendment status.

amendment_type.description: When is_amendment=true, one of 'RESTATEMENT' or 'NEW HOLDINGS'.

report_type.description: Filing role. Combination reports include positions held on behalf of other managers; Notice means the manager is filing nothing this quarter (covered elsewhere).

is_confidential_omitted.description: True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false.

table_entry_total.description: Cover-page count of holdings rows. Should equal len(holdings) — useful as a self-consistency check.

table_value_total_usd.description: Cover-page total market value across all positions. Since 2023-Q1 reported in whole dollars (was thousands earlier). Should equal sum(holdings[].value_usd).

holdings.description: InfoTable: one row per Section 13(f) reportable security. Each <infoTable> in the InfoTable XML maps to one record here.

issuer_name.description: nameOfIssuer, verbatim from filing (e.g. 'BROOKFIELD CORP', 'ACCENTURE PLC IRELAND'). Often uppercase.

title_of_class.description: Security class title (e.g. 'COM' for common stock, 'CL A LTD VT SH', 'SHS CLASS A', 'CALL', 'PUT', 'WTS'). Usually uppercase abbreviations, ≤150 chars.

cusip.description: 9-character CUSIP. XSD allows mixed case but most filings use uppercase. Normalize to uppercase for matching.

figi.description: Optional 12-character FIGI (Bloomberg). Reportable since 2023-Q1 amendments; most filers do not include it.

value_usd.description: Market value in whole dollars (integer). Pre-2023 filings used thousands; post-2023 always whole dollars.

shares_or_principal_amount.description: sshPrnamt: count of shares (when type=SH) or principal amount (when type=PRN).

shares_or_principal_type.description: SH=shares, PRN=principal-amount. Common stock is always SH; convertible bonds use PRN.

put_call.description: Set when the position is an option. Same CUSIP can appear three times in one filing: common stock + Call + Put.

investment_discretion.description: Manager's discretion: SOLE=sole, DFND=defined (with sub-advisors), OTR=other. Same security can appear under different discretions in the same filing.

other_manager.description: Optional reference to other_manager block when investment_discretion=DFND or =OTR. Free-form.

voting_authority_sole.description: Shares for which manager has sole voting authority.
